# ToolStand

> ToolStand is a privacy-first collection of 110 free online tools — no downloads, no sign-up. Every tool runs in your browser with zero data collection. Categories span developer utilities, calculators, converters, generators, image tools, text processing, SEO tools, and more. Built for speed, accessibility, and AI discoverability.

## About

- [Homepage](https://toolstand.io/): 110 free online tools with instant search and category filters
- [About](https://toolstand.io/about): Mission, features, and privacy commitment
- [Privacy Policy](https://toolstand.io/privacy): Zero data collection policy
- [Terms of Use](https://toolstand.io/terms): Usage terms

## Developer Tools

- [JSON Formatter](https://toolstand.io/tools/json-formatter): Format, validate, and minify JSON with tree view
- [JSON Minifier](https://toolstand.io/tools/json-minifier): Minify JSON to reduce size
- [JSON Compare](https://toolstand.io/tools/json-compare): Side-by-side JSON diff tool
- [JSON Schema Generator](https://toolstand.io/tools/json-schema-generator): Generate JSON Schema from sample data
- [JSONPath Tester](https://toolstand.io/tools/jsonpath-tester): Test JSONPath expressions
- [JSON to Java](https://toolstand.io/tools/json-to-java): Convert JSON to Java POJO classes
- [JWT Decoder](https://toolstand.io/tools/jwt-decoder): Decode JWT tokens and inspect headers/payloads
- [Hash Generator](https://toolstand.io/tools/hash-generator): Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 hashes
- [Base64 Encoder/Decoder](https://toolstand.io/tools/base64): Encode and decode Base64 strings
- [URL Encoder](https://toolstand.io/tools/url-encoder): URL encode/decode strings
- [HTML Entity Encoder](https://toolstand.io/tools/html-entity-encoder): Encode/decode HTML entities
- [UUID Generator](https://toolstand.io/tools/uuid-generator): Generate UUID v1 and v4 identifiers
- [Regex Tester](https://toolstand.io/tools/regex-tester): Test regular expressions with match highlighting
- [Regex Explainer](https://toolstand.io/tools/regex-explainer): Explain regex patterns in plain English
- [Diff Checker](https://toolstand.io/tools/diff-checker): Compare two texts side-by-side
- [SQL Formatter](https://toolstand.io/tools/sql-formatter): Format and beautify SQL queries
- [CSV/JSON Converter](https://toolstand.io/tools/csv-json-converter): Convert between CSV and JSON
- [XML Formatter](https://toolstand.io/tools/xml-formatter): Format and validate XML documents
- [XML/JSON Converter](https://toolstand.io/tools/xml-json-converter): Convert between XML and JSON
- [YAML Validator](https://toolstand.io/tools/yaml-validator): Validate and format YAML
- [Dockerfile Generator](https://toolstand.io/tools/dockerfile-generator): Generate Dockerfiles from templates
- [Cron Builder](https://toolstand.io/tools/cron-builder): Build and validate cron expressions
- [SSH Key Generator](https://toolstand.io/tools/ssh-key-generator): Generate SSH key pairs
- [Markdown Table Generator](https://toolstand.io/tools/markdown-table): Create markdown tables visually
- [Markdown Previewer](https://toolstand.io/tools/markdown-previewer): Preview markdown in real-time
- [Token Counter](https://toolstand.io/tools/token-counter): Count tokens for LLM prompts
- [Base Converter](https://toolstand.io/tools/base-converter): Convert between binary, octal, decimal, hex
- [Timestamp Converter](https://toolstand.io/tools/timestamp-converter): Convert Unix timestamps to human-readable dates
- [Whats My IP](https://toolstand.io/tools/whats-my-ip): Display your public IP address and location
